# vaultwarden_user_api_key (Ephemeral Resource)

Reads the personal API key of the provider user, for the Bitwarden CLI or the provider's `client_id` and `client_secret`, without storing it in the plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.10 or later.

The user gets an API key the first time it is read. Reading it requires the provider user's master password. Only the provider user's own key can be read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
ephemeral "vaultwarden_user_api_key" "example" {}

# Log in a second provider configuration with the personal API key
provider "vaultwarden" {
  alias           = "api_key"
  endpoint        = "https://vaultwarden.example.com"
  email           = var.email
  master_password = var.master_password
  client_id       = ephemeral.vaultwarden_user_api_key.example.client_id
  client_secret   = ephemeral.vaultwarden_user_api_key.example.client_secret
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String) Client ID of the API key, `user.<user_id>`.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client secret of the API key.
